title: Bloody Nightmare
description: The game is intended for players over the age of 18, as in it, you will need to feel like killers and kill live targets from the computer game Schoolboy runaway. - Beautiful graphics and effects. - Addictive gameplay. - 20 levels. When all living targets are destroyed, the level will be completed.
instructions: Choose the angle at which you want to launch the murder weapon by holding and pulling the mouse or finger over the selected area then release the mouse and the weapon will fly
